item.title: Lesson 01: Semester Kickoff
item.description:
Focus

Set up the semester portfolio and define a structure for documenting each lesson.

What We Worked On

  • configured Hugo with the Blowfish theme
  • created a post structure for lesson-based notes
  • shaped the visual identity of the portfolio

Key Takeaways

  • a clean workflow makes it easier to keep up with documentation
  • small reflections after each lesson will build into a strong semester overview

Next Time

Add the first real lesson summary with code snippets, screenshots, and links to related coursework.
